body:
anya: Quick preflight — pricing/packaging change goes to canary Thu 09:00 PT. Doing an owners sweep for metering, quota mapping, and contract hooks. Who's primary for the metering adapter?
sara-pm: tagging owners list from the doc: @leah-eng for adapter, @nishit for quota mapping, billing team for contract rules. need confirmation.
leah-eng: I can own the metering adapter code + canary rollout. will send a short PR today and ping reviewers.
nishit: I can take quota mapping and the edge-cases (rate-limit overlap). ETA for PR: tomorrow EOD.
mike-plat: I'll own the deploy gating and feature flag check. can we get the flag turned on only for the canary tenant list?
anya: yes — feature flag will be scoped to the repo list in the rollout doc. mike, can you add the flag gating to the canary runbook?
mike-plat: on it. adding runbook note and a smoke test step: validate per-tenant metering counts.
oliver-qa: can we get a short test matrix? I need 1) meter increment on success, 2) no double-count for retries, 3) correct plan delta when quota crosses threshold.
leah-eng: here's the quick test commands I used locally:
```
# smoke: single request
curl -X POST https://api.dev.internal/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST"
# check meter events
kubectl logs -l app=metering -n dev | tail -n 200 | grep "meter_event"
```

leah-eng: will add a small integration script to the PR for oliver to run.
billing-bot: billing-alert: contract-rule check passed for product-tier mapping (rule-id: cr-42). No mismatches detected in staging.
anya: thanks. two contract edgecases to decide before canary: 1) legacy free-tier users with custom quotas — should we preserve custom caps or map to new default? 2) trial conversions that were grandfathered.
sara-pm: decision: preserve custom caps. trial conversions: retain grandfathered allowances but flag for manual review if usage spikes > 3x baseline in 24h. I'll document this in the contract notes.
nishit: for quota mapping, preserving custom caps is fine; need a DB migration script to keep the kicker flag. I'll include migration and a backfill plan in the PR.
mike-plat: deploy-bot suggested preflight: run migration in read-only mode against a snapshot first, then apply.
deploy-bot: deploy-check: migration snapshot run passed on staging (duration 7m, sample 10k users). No schema drift.
oliver-qa: schedule me for a quick verification window Thu 08:15 PT? I can run the matrix and report in 30m.
leah-eng: ACK — I'll have the integration script + PR link by EOD so QA can run it.
anya: who will handle code review for the metering PR? need one infra eng + one billing review.
ishit: @mike-plat can review infra side. @sara-pm can you assign billing reviewer?
sara-pm: assigning @finance-amy from billing team for contract & billing review.
leah-eng: PR opened: https://gh.redwood/metrics/pr/412. pinged reviewers. CI: unit + integration.
leah-eng: note: the adapter requires a small config change (METER_BUFFER_MS default 50 -> 25) to meet latency SLO in canary.
mike-plat: config change is fine for canary, but gate it behind FF. I'll add the FF toggle and a config override in k8s.
anya: final ask list before canary: leah PR + CI green, nishit migration script + backfill plan, mike gating & runbook, oliver QA window, finance-amy billing signoff. If any blocker, call it out now.
oliver-qa: no blockers. will run tests Thu 08:15 PT.
finance-amy: will review billing impact and reply by Wed EOD.
sara-pm: tracking this in the rollout checklist (link: https://docs.redwood/rollouts/pricing-change). I'll update status when each item is done.
anya: awesome — short sync Thu 08:45 PT 15m to confirm go/no-go. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
